gyujeongion-claude-code-request-modes-re.description: A gate the agent passes before answering, to decide WHICH rules apply to THIS request. Classify the request into a context, activate only the layers (personas, rulebooks, constraints) that belong to it, and turn off the ones that don't. Stops a single global persona or rulebook from bleeding into every request, and stops "swing to the opposite extreme" when corrected. Use when your agent over-applies one set of rules everywhere, when it brings the wrong tone to a request, or when you say "/request-modes", "route this", "which mode is this".
